Hello world, we’re alive again!  

The UPS in the data enter where most parts of strafpla.net live broke a leg yesterday. People who I’m sharing a rack with organized parts and fixed stuff. I only know one name of those involved, so thank you Thomas!

(I used the chance to do some updates and ran into a strange problem with #docker and #caddyserver #alpine that I could only fix by downgrading. I’ll have a look at it later this week.)

#Mastoadmin
